objective.name: sandbox.dsl.mono.context
objective.description: Mono-instance cross-context DSL flow from alpha child to local root and back to a local wrapper-backed terminal result.

#root.role: Read root context state through the engine and return a local wrapper echo using the remote mono-instance context id.

effects.mono_instance_route: A same-instance cross-context reflexive call is awaited.
effects.local_wrapper_runtime: The local wrapper runtime is invoked for the terminal response.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one terminal wrapper response after a same-instance cross-context state read.
invariants: The flow always performs one same-instance cross-context read.state before the terminal wrapper call.
The terminal wrapper message is derived from root_state.payload.context.context_id.
Only one terminal wrapper invocation occurs.
success: On success, the terminal payload is the payload returned by the final local sandbox.echo call.
Successful execution proves mono-instance cross-context routing before local wrapper termination.
failure: The flow fails terminally if the cross-context read.state step cannot complete.
The flow also fails if the terminal local wrapper call cannot execute.
notes: This scenario exercises same-instance context routing without using the external boundary.
The capacity is intentionally simple and serves as a mono-instance orchestration oracle.
